svg.aria-label: What I built: Parses nested and embedded files with multi-modal parsing, so evidence is found whatever format it is in. Validates each remediation claim against the evidence it finds, and shows the evidence it relied on. Automates the closure check that tells reviewers whether an issue looks ready to close.
